follow-up time: Until age 13 years (up to 23 years of follow-up)
finding: While standard models showed an association between cesarean section and increased risk of affective disorders, sibling models refuted this association for pre-labor cesarean section, suggesting the association may not be causal and potentially explained by other factors.
mod_finding: Both pre-labor and intrapartum cesarean sections were associated with an increased risk of affective disorders in standard Cox models, but this association disappeared for pre-labor cesarean section in a sibling model.
